top_signals.title: Nothing Nefarious With 'Circle Financing': Dorrell
top_signals.summary:
Mike Dorrell, chairman CEO and co-founder, Stonepeak joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Nvidia is working on a fresh round of AI deals worth more than $750 billion, accelerating investments that skeptics have warned are artificially inflating demand and valuations across the industry. Such transactions have left many AI companies increasingly intertwined, potentially exposing the sector to systemic shocks.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Binance.US Wants to Join Prediction Markets Race With CFTC Stamp
top_signals.summary: Binance.US is planning to apply for a license with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission that would help it start its own prediction market, the company’s chief executive officer said at a conference on Wednesday.
